name: Soya Chunk and Vegetable Upma
ingredients: 25 g dry soy chunks, finely chopped after soaking
½ cup diced carrot, peas and beans
steps: Soak soy chunks in boiling water 10 minutes. Drain, rinse, squeeze dry and chop finely.
Dry-roast semolina in a pan for 3 minutes; transfer to a plate.
Heat oil; add mustard seeds, urad dal and curry leaves. Add onion, ginger and vegetables; cook 3 minutes.
Add chopped soy and stir for 2 minutes. Pour in hot water and bring to a simmer.
Rain in semolina while stirring. Cover and cook on low 4–5 minutes until fluffy. Finish with lemon.
note: Contains wheat and soy. Stir semolina in gradually to avoid lumps.
